'''Deezoth Caraz''' was a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]]. He posed as an importer/exporter to cover up his chosen profession. He traveled with a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] named [[Vok]].<ref name="Game" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]] with his bodyguard and two slaves he was to deliver to a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. During this visit, while getting drunk and gambling, he was poisoned by Vok and [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="Game" />

==Personality and traits==
He had a loathsome personality. He was amoral and liked to intimidate others.<ref name="Game" />
